prompt: Our data pipeline team needs a file watcher that automatically re-runs the aggregation script (`pipeline/src/aggregate.py`) every time any Python source file under `pipeline/src/` is modified. The watcher should run as a background process and all its output must be captured to `pipeline/logs/watcher.log`. Please create a script called `watcher_setup.sh` in the workspace that sets this up. To verify it works, also make sure that after the watcher is running, touching any `.py` file in `pipeline/src/` causes `pipeline/output/report.json` to be regenerated automatically.
